title: a host seam that cannot apply on this box's platform is not offered, so the install gate can reach green on Windows
intention: cairn install does not offer a host seam that declares it applies only to another platform: it reads not_applicable, never already_applied, and the install gate counts it green, so on Windows the gate reads green once every seam that can apply here has verified.
why: Measured 2026-11-12 on akiendell: on akiendell the installer dry-run check prints [OFFERED] usage-widget-hook and exits 1; gather_host_seams returns one seam; run_verify(seam) returns (False, '/usr/bin/bash: line 1: jq: command not found'); ~/.claude/usage-cache.json is absent; installer.py install() reads no platform field
traces_to: Law 4: the gate is physics only if it can be satisfied where it runs; Law 3: the offer was measured on the box, not assumed; Law 7: the skip carries a named reason.
how: Give a host-seam intention an optional platforms declaration (absent means every platform). install() reports a seam whose platforms exclude sys.platform as status not_applicable (skipped=platform, reason named) without running its verify; the inspector's red_of counts not_applicable green beside already_applied; usage-widget-hook declares linux only. Ruled by the orchestrator 2026-11-12: already_applied keeps its meaning (the seam is on the box).

the install gate passes a not_applicable seam and still refuses a red one beside it
